technique_name: Outline the major differences between a mammal and an amphibian.
description: Mammals and amphibians are two distinct classes of animals that differ significantly in anatomy, physiology, habitat, and lifestyle. Mammals are warm-blooded animals, featuring a fur- or hair-covered skin, specialized lungs, and mammary glands, while amphibians are cold-blooded animals, adapted to both land and water environments.
